description: This file defines the LogView class, which is a custom Android TextView used to display log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and appends them to the TextView for display.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView implementation for logging purposes that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, then propagates it to the next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the log display.
